entities.summary: Robert Linzeler was a French sailor who represented his country at the 1900 Summer Olympics in Meulan, France. With François Texier as helmsman and fellow crewmembers Jean-Baptiste Charcot and Auguste Texier, Linzeler took the 2nd place in first race of the 0 to 0.5 ton and finished 2nd in the second race.
